summary: This note is a short biography of Shane Alwyne Parker (1943–1992), a British-born museum curator and ornithologist. It covers his emigration to Australia in 1967 after an ornithological collecting expedition in 1964, his work as a curator at the South Australian Museum from 1976 to 1992, and his death from lymphoma at his Adelaide home after a two-year illness.
one_line: Shane Alwyne Parker was a British-born ornithologist and South Australian Museum curator who died of lymphoma in Adelaide in 1992.
key_facts: Shane Alwyne Parker was born on 3 August 1943.
Shane Alwyne Parker died on 21 November 1992.
Shane A. Parker was a museum curator and ornithologist.
Shane A. Parker emigrated to Australia in 1967.
Shane A. Parker participated in the second Harold Hall Australian ornithological collecting expedition in 1964.
Shane A. Parker worked as a curator at the South Australian Museum from 1976 to 1992.
Shane A. Parker died of lymphoma at his home in Adelaide.
Shane A. Parker's final illness lasted two years.
